worldcombat.skill.metalclaw.summary: Rake the target at close range along free aim - two lighter rakes or one heavier hone; each landed rake may hone the user's Attack. Swinging into open air is allowed, and walls block the claws.
worldcombat.skill.metalclaw.use.0: Rake twice left and right at point-blank range
worldcombat.skill.metalclaw.use.1: Hone a little Attack with every landed rake
worldcombat.skill.metalclaw.use.2: Feed itself into a heavy striker within the first beats
Each rake deals about %1$s contact damage with a %2$s-block claw radius; the foe's Defence, type matchup and crits are settled on hit.

The claws truly reach %1$s blocks along free aim and the first body or wall stops them; target selection adds about a 0.4-block body margin on top. The twin form lands its second rake %2$s ticks later, knocks the target %3$s blocks along the actual claw line, and the second rake only reads the current aim for a small correction.

On a landed rake, %1$s chance to hone an edge and raise Attack by up to %2$s stage(s), a cap shared by every rake of one cast and shown as the stages actually gained; the honed Attack stays and makes later physical moves heavier.
worldcombat.skill.metalclaw.hone.on: Hone form: one single heavier rake with a higher hone chance, more knockback and a little more reach, but a longer windup and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.metalclaw.hone.off: Twin form: two rakes that each roll to hone; faster and cheaper, each lighter, and the second rake may correct its aim a little.
worldcombat.skill.metalclaw.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recover %3$s s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.metalclaw.growth.1: Lv.%1$s: rake damage %2$s, up to %3$s Attack stage per cast.
worldcombat.skill.metalclaw.preference.h: On (heavy-claw form): one single heavier rake, higher hone chance, more knockback and a little more reach, but a longer windup and cooldown. Off (twin form): two rakes that each roll to hone; faster and cheaper, each lighter.
worldcombat.skill.metalclaw.preference.a: Only rake when the foe is within this range; the claw reach is short, so a larger value still means closing in first.
On: while Attack is below +4 stages, prefer raking to build it up. Off: rank it like any ordinary melee hit and use it as a cheap chip.
